About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: Engineering Impactful Software Solutions
About.description: Computer Science graduate from the University of Virginia with experience architecting full-stack applications, training deep learning models, and conducting research. Specialized in building scalable systems that process real-world data, from fintech learning platforms to ML pipelines analyzing satellite imagery. Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering best practices. Proven ability to deliver measurable impact through clean, maintainable code and innovative problem-solving.

projects.description: Stack: Python, LangChain, GPT-4, FAISS, Streamlit\nRAG-based semantic search system
details: Built RAG-based tool using LangChain and GPT-4 for semantic search over 500+ PubMed abstracts with FAISS vector database, enabling natural language queries across medical research literature.
Implemented custom embedding pipeline using sentence-transformers for domain-specific medical terminology, with semantic chunking strategy improving retrieval precision over keyword-based search.
Deployed to Streamlit Cloud for student users with response caching and query optimization for fast vector similarity search.

projects.description: Stack: Python, TensorFlow, ResNet50, GIS\nDeep learning for crop yield prediction
details: Collaborated with a capstone team to build CNN pipeline using ResNet50 with attention pooling for county-level corn yield prediction, processing satellite imagery, elevation and census data (NDVI, DEM) through custom data fusion architecture.
Evaluated on counties across VA/MD/WV with hyperparameter tuning (Adam optimizer, learning rate scheduling), and extended the model to classify multiple crop types.

Presented at UVA CS Capstone Showcase demonstrating scalable ML inference pipeline generating actionable crop suitability heatmaps, enabling data-driven agricultural resource allocation and sustainability planning.

projects.insideTitle: Deep Learning Brain Tumor Segmentation System
projects.description: Stack: Python, TensorFlow, U-Net, OpenCV\nMedical image analysis
details: Implemented U-Net architecture for brain tumor segmentation on 200 manually-annotated MRI scans as part of UVA Medical Image Analysis Lab, improving the Dice coefficient over the baseline on the validation set.

Integrated imaging data via secure APIs with comprehensive error handling, implementing data augmentation techniques (rotation, flipping, elastic deformation) to improve model generalization across imaging protocols.
Presented findings at UVA Engineering Research Symposium (November 2023), comparing 3 CNN architectures (U-Net, V-Net, ResUNet) for medical image segmentation with quantitative performance metrics.

projects.description: Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite\nModern restaurant tracking web application
details: Built a restaurant discovery front end with React 18 and TypeScript featuring feed system, search functionality, and user authentication. Implemented Context API for state management over mock restaurant data with real-time filtering and CRUD operations.

Engineered responsive UI with Tailwind CSS supporting mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. Created reusable component library (Button, Card, Input) with consistent design system featuring smooth animations and hover effects.

Architected clean component structure with React Router v6 for navigation across 5+ pages (Feed, Add, Detail, Discover, Auth). Designed for future backend integration with PostgreSQL and JWT authentication.

projects.insideTitle: Personal Portfolio Website with Real-Time Stats
projects.description: Stack: React, JavaScript, CSS3, EmailJS\nInteractive developer portfolio
details: Developed responsive portfolio website with React featuring dark mode toggle, real-time GitHub API integration displaying contribution stats and repository data, and LeetCode stats integration with difficulty breakdown.
Built comprehensive project showcase with modal views, live demo links, and GitHub repository integration. Implemented EmailJS for contact form with validation and success/error handling.

Created dynamic achievements section highlighting Dean's List honors, open source contributions to Hugging Face Transformers, and research presentations. Responsive design supporting all device sizes.

projects.description: Stack: PHP, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Docker\nFull-stack fintech education platform
details: Architected full-stack fintech platform using a PHP backend, PostgreSQL database, and Docker containerization. Implemented real-time stock market simulator with WebSocket connections handling concurrent user requests.
Built OAuth 2.0 authentication system with JWT session management and role-based access control (RBAC). Optimized database queries with indexing.
Engineered responsive dashboards with Chart.js visualizations and community forums using AJAX, with gamified investment challenges and peer-to-peer learning features.
